en: Welcome! This is a Pokémon Gym, and a rock club too! Roxie and her band are rehearsing downstairs.
Take on everyone in there! Oh, and stay hydrated. It gets hot under those stage lights.
The Trainers here all use Poison types. Grass and Bug moves don't work well against them, so watch out!
And if your Pokémon get poisoned, an Antidote or a Pecha Berry will sort them out.
That Badge shines because you and your Pokémon won it together. Never forget that!
